whole.reason: full extraction energy not measured continuously; cached encoding energy not interchangeable

protocol.selection: Same frozen ten images per each of five retained datasets. Illustrative collection selected before this sensitivity experiment; no selection based on current outcomes.
protocol.features: Reuse 200 frozen DINOv3 PCA16 grids. Whole image and local 5/10/20%; local crops enlarged to384x384, inverse-aligned four-flip averaging, approximately75% overlap and Hann blending. Aspect-preserving grid with longest side256. No AnyUp, shared cluster centers, vegetation mask, XY distance features, additional unit-vector normalization or whitening.
protocol.varimax: Orthogonal varimax of the frozen 768-by-d PCA projection basis, d=3 or16 retained separately. Kaiser row normalization only during loading optimization, restored before projection. Five deterministic starts, SVD iteration, tolerance1e-9,max1000. Select largest criterion; canonical order by loading concentration and sign by largest absolute basis coefficient. Rotated basis B R, rotated scores X R. This explicitly uses projection-weight loadings, not the alternative covariance-loading/factor-score whitening convention. All d rotated axes retained, so reconstructed subspace and Euclidean distances unchanged. Rotated scores can be correlated and are no longer ordered by PCA variance. First3 rotated axes are displayed with equal per-method pooled2/98 percentiles; no cluster fit uses displayed RGB.
protocol.mle_gmm: Full covariance, n_init3,seed42,reg_covar1e-5,tol0.001,max_iter300,retry600. Refit ALL K1..12 in float64 on the same fixed8192-or-fewer coordinates; sample hash checked against prior experiment. Float64 ensures internally consistent candidate fits; tiny numerical/local-optimum differences from earlier float32 fits are reported. Score=-2*sum(logdensity)+lambda*p*log(n), p=K*(d+d*(d+1)/2)+K-1. Minimum converged score; smallerK exact ties. Lambda1 ordinaryBIC; higher values explicitly stronger penalty. No scores compared across dimensionalities.
protocol.mle_maps: Use each selected fitted full-covariance model, transform means as means R and covariances as R.T covariance R, and verify pointwise density and predicted partition invariance. Maximum-responsibility assignment across all grid locations; no new DINO extraction.
protocol.bayesian_gmm: BayesianGaussianMixture; full covariance; maximum12 components; Dirichlet-process stick-breaking prior; alpha0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100. Same8192 sample and retained subspace as MLE; fit rotated scores in float64. Seed42,n_init1,tol0.001,max_iter500,retry1000,warm_start. Mean precision1, covariance and degrees-of-freedom priors sklearndefaults (empirical full covariance and d). These variational priors are distinct from multiplying BIC. All convergence states reported. OccupiedK means unique hard assignments across full grid; additionally show components of weight>=1% and>=2%, without deleting or assigning rare groups forcibly. For cases exhausting the initial budget, extend with a5000-iteration warm continuation at the same tolerance; all2400 final models must converge. Warnings from earlier stages are retained alongside the final convergence flag.
protocol.kmeans: Existing automatic K-means selection and labels are retained as orthogonal-invariance reference. K3..12, spatial-fold silhouette, closest5 among candidates within1SE; final8192 sample,n_init10,seed42. Thus current baseline already includes a soft preference toward5; it is not completely preference-free. Independent original/rotated refits verify10 representative cases.
protocol.distribution: Empirical frequency across50 images or10 within each domain, separately per feature method and retained dimension. SelectedK is fitted mixture count; occupiedK and area fractions also reported. Not a posterior over species, accuracy score or representative estimate for all ecological images.
protocol.limitations: Spatially correlated interpolated and overlapping-context features are not independent observations. Penalty and alpha effects depend on sample count, dimensionality and priors; no universally optimal settings inferred. Counts4..6 are a user preference, not biological ground truth. No reviewed object masks are used. Strong penalties can collapse to1 or2 groups, and12 is upper search/truncation limit. Varimax improves loading interpretability/display axes but cannot improve rotation-invariant full-covariance or Euclidean clustering by itself.
protocol.stability: Earlier frozen ten-image subset, two per domain, local10% both3/16 dimensions. Three fits from two-thirds of8x8 spatial blocks per image; each uses8192 locations, same n as primary. Refit/select all K1..12 for every lambda in each fold; compare selected maps on fixed2048 common probe locations viaARI. Count variation andARI describe repeatability; overlapping/global DINO context means spatial folds remain dependent. No ground truth.

phase1-benchmark.block_unit: site/session; spatial plot correlations across sessions may remain

protocol.feature_normalization: raw 768D tokens; no explicit L2 normalization
protocol.pca: Shared centered unwhitened PCA16 per photo, equal eligible token counts per method from original inputs only; frozen for mirrored inputs and future methods
protocol.render: Bilinear token interpolation; crop Hann blending with per-axis floor .05; no AnyUp or flip/shift ensemble
protocol.clustering: Separate K-means per method, K=4/6/8, n_init10 seed42; 4096 matched eligible spatial samples; mirrored field predicted with the original fitted centers
protocol.robustness: Independent horizontal reflection pass, flip outputs back, exclude 16px margins; no reflection averaging
protocol.edge_proxy: Grayscale sigma1 Sobel, strongest 15% eligible RGB gradients, 2px boundary tolerance. An appearance proxy, not botanical truth.
protocol.seam_proxy: RMS feature jumps near crop starts/ends versus off-seam jumps matched within RGB-contrast deciles and orientation. Ratio 1 means no excess, not perfect segmentation. Whole-image evaluated at same hypothetical crop lines.
protocol.runtime: GPU-synchronized per-input encoding time and peak allocated GPU bytes. Shared PCA and CPU evaluation timings recorded separately. Model warmup excluded.
protocol.uncertainty: 2000 paired site/session-block bootstrap replicates; pooled-photo means and site means; not independent-pixel inference
protocol.references: No ground truth currently. Leaf IoU and boundary accuracy remain unmeasured. Reference masks may be added through score_leaf_references.py.

fourflip-benchmark.block_unit: site/session; repeated physical plots may remain correlated across sessions

protocol.design: Matched 3 scale x 2 flip-average factorial; no-flip cells reused from frozen Phase 1 results.
protocol.four_flip_operation: DINO raw 768D token grids are inverse-reflected into the original crop coordinates, averaged before the frozen Phase 1 PCA projection, interpolation, and crop blending.
protocol.frozen_settings: Use each image Phase 1 PCA mean/basis, RGB display range, eligible evaluation mask, and 4096 training coordinates; fit separate KMeans per new treatment at K=4/6/8, n_init=10, seed=42.
protocol.image_normalization: processor RGB mean/std after 0-1 scaling; no L2 feature normalization
protocol.metrics: RGB-edge boundary F1 and seam excess are image-derived diagnostics, not leaf accuracy; cluster occupancy/effective clusters/boundary density are descriptive.
protocol.flip_stability: The independent flip ARI/feature error are not reported for four-flip means because that transformation is included in the estimator.
protocol.leaf_accuracy: Not measured; no reviewed leaf masks or leaf-instance predictions are available.
protocol.uncertainty: 2000 paired bootstrap resamples of site/session blocks; repeated plots may remain correlated across sessions.

protocol.input: Existing cleaned working RGB, longest side <=1280. Crop size is round(shorter side * fraction), minimum16. Crop stride round(2/3 crop). Bicubic resize each crop to384x384. Processor RGB /255 and mean/std.
protocol.features: Raw 768D DINOv3 tokens, no explicit L2 normalization. Four orientations (identity, horizontal, vertical, both), inverse-reflect token grids, average in float32, cast float16 as in prior benchmark.
protocol.fusion: Project all scales with the same frozen per-photo centered PCA16. Bilinear interpolation, Hann blend (per-axis floor0.05), normalize overlap weights separately for each scale. Arithmetic mean of these aligned scale fields, equal weights summing to1. Centered affine projection and unit-sum averaging commute, so fusion before or after this fixed projection is equivalent up to floating point. PCA colors and cluster IDs are never averaged.
protocol.clustering: Separate KMeans per treatment; K=4,6,8, n_init10, seed42; same4096 frozen eligible coordinates. Frozen PCA/display limits/valid mask; no shared cluster centers.
protocol.mask: Prior artifact exclusions plus16px erosion; whole-image vegetation content is otherwise retained. No vegetation scoring mask.
protocol.primary_score: RGB-edge boundary F1, K6. Grayscale sigma1 Sobel, strongest15% eligible gradients,2px tolerance. Appearance proxy; not leaf IoU or botanical accuracy.
protocol.seams: Existing contrast/orientation-matched seam ratio. All treatments evaluated against every one of the four identical test grids; 10% grid primary, other grids sensitivity. Distance |ratio-1| is descriptive and may miss visible lattice artifacts.
protocol.runtime: One GPU worker,12 crops/batch. Per-scale encoding time includes RGB crop preparation and four model orientations, excludes projection/blending/clustering. Mixture encoding cost is the sum of constituent scale times; reuse means it is an estimated standalone encoding cost, not an independently timed full run.
protocol.cache: Float32 PCA16 scale fields and K6 labels retained on server for reuse. Results and previews copied locally.
protocol.uncertainty: Exploratory pilot; balanced sites and rank strata. Paired site/session-block bootstrap stratified by site, equal site weights,5000 draws. Repeated spatial plots and rank-selection uncertainty are not fully modeled. No multiplicity adjustment; not confirmatory inference.
protocol.leaf_accuracy: Not measured: no reviewed leaf-instance masks.
